
Source vs. Graphic

In Computational Systems Engineering, there are 2 fundamental forms of Human-Computer-Interaction: Source (Plaintext) and Interactive (Graphical).

## Category
Characteristics of...

Source maximizes power but reduces tangibility as a cost, While Graphics maximize tangibility, reducing power as a cost. They are two sides of the same coin: Solving the fundamental problem of HCI.

Source can represent \*virtually anything in theory. One can represent a matrix simply by stating: "rows [1,2,3]" and "columns [a,b,c]". However, while this is Ergonomic (Maximiginz the Affordances of Linguistic...) It is not the Intuiitve ... of Graphics.
